headline: ScreenConnect flaw exploited against MSPs; Java4Shell now 10 outlets; Nginx HTTP/2 pre-auth RCE reported; Puppet RCE still under attack

bullets.text: New, critical: a ScreenConnect flaw (CVE-2026-84869) is exploited to run malicious files on MSP technician accounts, per Cybersecurity Dive; 3 outlets now cover it.

Developing, critical: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) grew from 8 to 10 outlets. The Hacker News says it enables pre-auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and more and CISA urges immediate patching; Help Net Security says exploitation hinges on specific CPUs.
New: Wiz reports pre-auth RCE vulnerabilities in Nginx HTTP/2 handling (via Hacker News). No CVE or fixed version is given in the brief.
Still active: the Perforce Puppet Enterprise RCE (CVE-2026-115731) is exploited and in CISA KEV with a federal due date of 12-01. Apache also warns its Roller RCE is exploited (no CVE in the brief).

Supply chain: pip agent-framework 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 (Microsoft Agent Framework) were poisoned with a credential stealer; BleepingComputer and The Register now also report it. The Optimizely malicious-code incident remains at 7 outlets.

Incidents: the Equinor cyberattack is now at 4 outlets; ransomware hit Wilmington School District 209U; Charleston County is investigating an incident. SITCON 3 unchanged; 7-day score 0.87x the 90-day average; n0n (78) leads leak-site claims.

actions: ScreenConnect operators and MSPs: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-84869 now and review technician accounts for unexpected file execution.
Inventory Java runtimes and apps such as Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak; apply Oracle and vendor fixes for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) as CISA urges.
Nginx users: read Wiz's HTTP/2 RCE write-up and watch for fixes; consider limiting HTTP/2 exposure on internet-facing servers until patched.
Puppet Enterprise admins: patch CVE-2026-115731 (exploited, KEV due 12-01) and restrict network access to the Puppet server.
Search lockfiles and environments for pip agent-framework 1.26.1 or 1.26.2; remove them and rotate cloud credentials on affected hosts.
Queue KEV fixes: SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 due 11-20; Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium due 11-24.
